description: This file contains assembly code for a MIPS-based bootloader, specifically an LZMA compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It includes startup routines, CPU configuration, cache management, memory initialization, and jump to the main loader routine.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Entry point of the bootloader assembly code that sets up CPU status, cache, memory, and jumps to the main loader routine.
